headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, product names. Use lowercase for a modern 'brutalist' feel or all-caps for authority.

mono.usage: Technical specs, SKU numbers, 'Add to Cart' labels.

rules: NO GRADIENTS. Flat, solid colors only.
Use texture (noise, grain) instead of color variation.
Dark mode is not a toggle, it is a section-specific choice (e.g., Hero is dark, Product Grid is light).
Product cards should vary in height (aspect-ratio-3/4 vs aspect-ratio-1/1).
Use negative space as a design element.

buttons.style: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or Pill (rounded-full). NEVER default rounded-md.
buttons.interaction: Hover: Invert colors (Black bg/White text -> White bg/Black text with border).

cards.hover: No lift. Image zoom (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden container.

inputs.style: Underline only (border-b border-zinc-300) or solid block (bg-zinc-100). No standard outlined inputs.

navigation.style: Floating glass or sticky solid border-b.
navigation.content: Minimal. Logo left, 'Cart (0)' right. Menu center.

interaction_patterns: Smooth transition to 'Exploded View' on click (if applicable).
Color picker updates material prop instantly.
three_d_strategy.performance: Use 'useGLTF' with Draco compression. Lazy load models.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a fixed position div with 'bg-noise' opacity-5 pointer-events-none z-50 over the whole app.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions. Fade up + Blur in (y: 20, opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(10px)').
visual_enhancers.cursors: Custom SVG cursor (circle) that expands on hoverable elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use 'Inter' font. Import 'Bodoni Moda' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.css.
Ensure all images have 'object-cover' and 'grayscale' (optional hover: grayscale-0) class.
For the 3D viewer, create a dedicated component 'ProductViewer3D.jsx'.
Implement a 'CartDrawer' using Sheet component from Shadcn.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts, no blue primary buttons.
Spacing: Use p-8, p-12, p-24. Don't be afraid of empty space.
Micro-interactions: Every button needs a hover state. Every page needs an entrance animation.
Accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios. Use semantic HTML.
Data-TestId: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
